issue.title: Remove deprecated `ioutil.ReadAll`
issue.body:
## Description

Replace `ioutil.ReadAll` with `io.ReadAll`.

Some tests in `command_test.go` use the `ioutil.ReadAll` function from `io/ioutils` package. This package is deprecated as of Go 1.16, and the documentation advises to replace it with `io.ReadAll`

## References

- `io/ioutil` package documentation: https://pkg.go.dev/io/ioutil
- `ioutil.ReadAll` documentation: https://pkg.go.dev/io/ioutil#ReadAll
